title: Signal: Cargo replaces a registry with another source
scope: A Cargo.toml file that declares a `replace-with` rule that redirects a registry to another source.
limitations: It matches a `replace-with` rule that redirects a registry to another source in the parsed Cargo.toml; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A Cargo.toml that mentions a `replace-with` rule that redirects a registry to another source in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
